photo.alt: Caracas seen from Cerro El Ávila
photo.credit: Olga Berrios, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

facts: 920 m up in a valley of the coastal mountains
worth_knowing: Officially Santiago de León de Caracas, founded in 1567. A steep 2,200 m mountain range, Cerro El Ávila, separates the valley from the Caribbean shore.
